aws.name: AWS
aws.note: Body is 'healthy: dynamodb.<region>…', so the page can confirm the region.

oracle.name: Oracle Cloud
oracle.note: GET closes the connection after every 404 (each sample ≈ 3–4 RTT); HEAD reuses it.

vultr.name: Vultr
vultr.note: GET returns a ~12 KB page and adds 50–70 ms; HEAD avoids the body.

azure.name: Microsoft Azure
azure.note: CNAME chain ends at <region>.cloudapp.azure.com. Very stable samples.

gcp.name: Google Cloud
gcp.note: HEAD adds a fixed ~1 s, never use it. Per-region IPs (34.1.x), not the global anycast front end.

tencent.note: GET 403 closes the connection; HEAD reuses it.

linode.name: Akamai (Linode)
linode.note: Legacy speedtest.<dc>.linode.com hosts no longer answer; only regions with an Object Storage cluster are covered.

digitalocean.name: DigitalOcean
